releaseNotes: AURA 3.4.0: Balance mode - mark a REF stem (your kick) and Auto-Mix advice anchors to it, respecting your gain staging instead of absolute dBFS targets. Plus 10 stem slots (room for a noise bed), feather-light Link senders (near-zero CPU), and single-master link consumption fixing shredded stem audio when multiple AURA instances coexist.
